body_template: The tool and controller now share the strict Pydantic creation boundary in Utils/input_validation.py. It preserves non-coercion, literal prompt/instruction bytes, defaults, length checks and stable ValueError categories; model-supplied authority fields still cannot grant access. Complete validation/integration/note owners passed194 cases at their recorded source. Publication: {published_head}; exact follow-up qualification and source mappings are in the QA README.

SQLite writer contention now refuses immediately using the operation-owned acceptance connection with scoped busy_timeout=0, restored in finally. Actual file-lock controls verify refusal and event-loop progress. Acceptance retains the no-await source/target cutoff; simply moving it off-thread would let authority change after the last guard. Native conversation commit is separately owned, shielded and drained off-thread. Cold connection opening and FULL fsync remain synchronous; this does not claim all I/O latency is bounded. Publication: {published_head}; connection/restore/cancellation evidence and this remaining limit are recorded in the Task4 report.

The public validator wrapper now has Google-style Args, Returns and Raises sections describing the accepted fields, validated mapping and stable ValueError boundary. The shared validator retains the actual creation contract. Publication: {published_head}; Task3 validation and static evidence is retained in QA.

Runtime and saved metadata now use shared named chat-start status values in the already-loaded message_metadata module. Validation and outcome paths use the same vocabulary without adding an eager startup module. Publication: {published_head}; complete lifecycle and final startup qualification are documented in QA.

Removed the duplicate active-run ten-cell addition. REDIRECT_ACTION_WIDTH remains the single reservation. External geometry controls and mounted activation/deactivation coverage verify the fitting boundary and stable layout; the complete composer owner passed36 cases at its recorded source. Publication: {published_head}; exact RED/GREEN receipts are retained in QA.

Saved transcript notes now label machine-origin requests Agent handoff and untrusted requests Unverified handoff. Ordinary human User and assistant labels, span selection and provenance remain intact. Original note owners and explicit provenance controls passed. Publication: {published_head}; Task3 evidence and final source mappings are retained in QA.

Accepted, unreceipted work now settles to the existing review_required ledger state and atomically pauses its canonical shared allowance. It remains charged, including a conversation-side rollback after ledger acceptance: refunding an already accepted attempt would violate ADR-219 and could enable replay. Failed durable settlement retains an owner-fenced runtime restriction; replacement-owner recovery is preserved. Physical native commit work drains before capacity release or uncertain settlement. Real ledger, cancellation and replacement-owner overlap controls passed, with exact evidence in Task4. Publication: {published_head}.
